loading.title: Loading
loading.description: When the log pane is scrolled to the bottom, new logs automatically stream as they are added.

continuous.description: Camera image will always be a live stream when visible on the dashboard, even if no activity is being detected.
continuous.warning: Continuous streaming may cause high bandwidth usage and performance issues. Use with caution.

compatibility.title: Compatibility mode
compatibility.description: Enable this option only if your camera's live stream is displaying color artifacts and has a diagonal line on the right side of the image.
